text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #3499 is blocked by a flaky test in the image-diff suite on macOS and linux-shard2. Failing only in CI, passes locally for me. Anyone seen this one recently? :eyes:
ci-bot: build 3499.2 failed on macos-12-shard2 — test_image_snapshot (image-diff) — exit 1
ci-bot: logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/3499.2 (truncated)
sam: I saw something similar yesterday. It looked like a nondeterministic renderer output — different antialiasing on mac runners.
devon: Do we have seed control for that test? If it's image fuzz maybe we can make it deterministic or compare with a tolerance instead of strict snapshot.
jen: pinging @sam @alex — Sam, did you end up updating the snapshot or just flagged it as flaky?
sam: flagged it. Didn't want to update snapshots without root cause. I can reproduce locally with macos-12 docker image though, will try to capture diff.
alex: If the diff is just a few pixels we can switch the test to use per-pixel tolerance of 2 or use SSIM. But need to be careful for regressions.
priya: For unblock: can we do a targeted rerun of shard2? If it's transient rerun might clear it and we can merge.
maria: I'd prefer a deterministic fix, but we need to unblock the release branch. I'll request a targeted rerun first.
jen: Approvals: who can approve snapshot updates if we decide to accept the new image? @devon?
devon: I can approve snapshot updates for infra-related snapshots. If this is a product change we need design + QA sign-off.
sam: quick repro steps I ran locally (mac host):
```
# reproduce failing test locally
export CI_OS=macos-12
ci/test_runner --shard image-diff --filter test_image_snapshot --repeat 5
```
Logs show alternating diffs with small gamma differences.
maria: thanks, Sam. If repeating 5 times flips between pass/fail that's a flake. I will open a tiny follow-up PR with a test change to add a tolerance and mark the test flaky while we root cause it. Can someone review fast? :pray:
alex: I can review a small test-only PR today. Tag me in it.
priya: Also suggest adding an env variable guard so the tolerance only applies on CI runners, not local dev, to avoid masking regressions.
devon: Good call. Add a comment about why tolerance exists and link the CI failure.
sam: I'll attach a sample diff artifact: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/3499/image-diff-001.png — shows subtle banding near the top-left.
maria: OK I'm going to: 1) request targeted rerun, 2) open PR with tolerance-on-ci + docs comment, 3) request alex/devon review, 4) follow up with snapshot update if rerun still fails.
ci-bot: targeted rerun requested for build 3499.2 by maria — queued on shard2
jen: tagging @alex for review since Alex offered. Alex — if you can OK the test PR I'll merge and then do snapshot update follow-up.
alex: Will look in ~45m. If it's small and well-commented I can approve.
priya: If we merge the test-tolerance change, add a regression card in the release board to track root-cause follow-up. Don't want to forget.
maria: adding card now. Thanks all. I'll post status once rerun finishes. :thumbsup:
